cash.businessDateHint: It is the date of the NIGHT. A session that crosses midnight stays on the same day.
cash.cashOutHint: Bought in {{value}}. Zero is valid — a player who lost it all still stands up.
cash.cashboxClosedHint: Open your cash desk before moving money.
cash.closeBlockedHint: Stand every player up before closing
cash.closeDayHint: The day revenue will be FROZEN. Every table must be closed — the last count of each one settles the books.
cash.closeHint: The final count ends this table. The night total adds the partial counts already recorded ({{parcial}}).
cash.configSubtitle: Stakes, buy-in and rake. A table snapshots these values when it opens — editing here does not change tables already running.
cash.daysSubtitle: Revenue by day. This period totalled {{value}} in rake.
cash.floorSubtitle: Cash game tables, waiting list and the day cash desk
cash.gameTypeDeactivated: Game type deactivated (already used by tables)
cash.jackpotHint: The jackpot is not club revenue: it builds up in its own fund until it is paid out.
cash.maxBuyInHint: Empty = no cap. The cap applies when SITTING; a rebuy tops chips back up and is not limited by it.
cash.minBuyInHint: Market practice is 50 to 100 big blinds.
cash.noDayOpenHint: Cash game is measured by day. Open the day to release the tables — the date is the NIGHT: a session that crosses midnight is still the same day.
cash.noDaysHint: Open the day from the Floor to start operating.
cash.noGameTypes: Create a game type (stakes, buy-in and rake) before opening the first table.
cash.noGameTypesHint: Create a game type before opening tables
cash.noTablesHint: Open the first table to start seating players.
cash.openDayNote: Totals appear once the day is closed — while it is open, the live number is on the Floor.
cash.rakeConfigNote: These values guide whoever takes the rake at the table. The revenue recorded is the one COUNTED in the table rake box at closing — the system does not see hand by hand.
cash.rakeHint: The rake is COUNTED in the table box, not calculated. It is already in the cash desk as the difference between what came in and what went out — that is why recording it does not move the balance.
cash.rebuyHint: A rebuy tops lost chips back up and is not limited by the table cap.
cash.standError: Could not stand the player up
cash.tableNumberHint: It is the number on the floor — staff carry chips by it.
cash.moveHint: The player takes the chips along. Nothing enters or leaves the cash desk, and their result for the night stays the same.

cashWaitlist.addError: Could not add to the list
cashWaitlist.emptyHint: When the room fills up, note here who is waiting for a seat.
cashWaitlist.guestCannotReserve: Register the player to reserve the seat
cashWaitlist.guestHint: For someone not registered yet. The account can be created later, when they sit down.
cashWaitlist.minutesHint: Once the time is up the seat goes back to the room on its own.
cashWaitlist.needName: Choose the player or type a name
cashWaitlist.noDayHint: The waiting list belongs to the day. Open the day on the Floor to start taking names.
cashWaitlist.reserveHint: The reservation holds the seat while the player comes over. Buying chips still happens at the cash desk, on the table screen.
cashWaitlist.subtitle: {{count}} in line, by game. Order is by arrival; the number is the place in line and moves up on its own when someone sits.

cashJackpot.descPlaceholder: e.g. Quad 8s lost to a straight flush
cashJackpot.needDay: Open the operating day to pay
cashJackpot.noPayoutsHint: The pot grows with every table count and goes out when a prize is paid.
cashJackpot.payHint: The amount LEAVES the cash desk: it shows up in the end-of-night count like any other payout. Available in the pot: {{saldo}}.
cashJackpot.subtitle: Pot built from a slice of the pots. It is the players’ money held for payout — it is not club revenue.

cashReports.bestDaysHint: Ranked by what the club kept, not by what went through the drawer.
cashReports.byPlayerHint: The result belongs to the player — the money they won came from the others at the table, not from the club’s cash desk.
cashReports.byTableHint: This is what tells you which stake is worth keeping open.
cashReports.byWeekdayHint: Average per day operated — a total would reward the weekday that simply came up more often.
cashReports.emptyHint: Pick another period, or open an operating day on the Floor.
cashReports.subtitle: Revenue is the RAKE. Buy-in turnover is shown because it is the night’s movement, but almost all of it goes back to the player at cash-out.
cashReports.title: Cash game revenue

mfa.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. It works once and will TURN OFF two-step verification — you can set up a new device right after.

mfa.errorInvalidRecovery: Recovery code invalid or already used.
mfa.errorLoadFactors: Could not load your verification methods.

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Two-step verification asks for a code from your phone on top of your password.
security.offHint: With it on, someone who learns your password still cannot get into your account without your phone.
security.scanHint: Scan the code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password) and type the 6-digit number it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.confirmDisable: Turn off two-step verification? Your account goes back to being protected by the password alone.
security.errorInvalidCode: Invalid code. Check the app and try again.
security.codesLow: Generate a new list while you can still sign in.
security.codesWarning: Write these codes down now and keep them off your phone. They will not be shown again, and each one works once. Without them, losing your phone means losing access to the account.
